Three CC adoption rows

what our docs said vs what CC does since 2.1.216-218 · closes #3068 #3066 #3092 · doc-only, no behavior change

#3068 · worktree git escape closed (2.1.216)

docs before

worktree isolation described as
"each agent gets its own copy" —
silent on the escape hatch:
a worker could git -C / GIT_DIR
its way into the SHARED checkout
and mutate it anyway

docs after

worktree-agent-pattern.md:
isolation is ENFORCED, not
advisory — the escape fails
loudly since 2.1.216; route
parent-tree git through the
coordinator, never a worker
+ matrix row

docs before

change — nothing on managed

docs after

new operator paragraph:
managed OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_

ork action: none (no managed

#3092 · /code-review backgrounds (2.1.218)

docs before

review-pr compared against
2.1.202 semantics: /code-review
described as an inline pass you

Scope. Four files, doc-only: two review-pr comparison blocks, one worktree-pattern note, one OTEL operator paragraph, three version-compatibility matrix rows. With these, the CC-adoption milestone drops to a single open item — #3238, the empirical background-behavior experiment.
